responses.title: A complete small repeatability study supports a limited positive result
responses.assessment_basis: Supplied synthetic snapshot only; planned scenario operations below were not actually executed.

current_contract.obligation: Report the small completed repeatability study without adding work
conditions: All 16 allocated slots per arm complete
current_contract.authorized_scope: Report results only; no default-on installation

evidence_to_claim.claim_or_action: F has an observed 10/16 pass count versus baseline 8/16 in this sample
evidence_to_claim.reason: The frozen candidate, fixed conditions, fresh controls and full denominator support this descriptive comparison: 62.5% versus 50%, +12.5 percentage points.

evidence_to_claim.claim_or_action: F improves all-repeat consistency without eliminating all-failure tasks
evidence_to_claim.reason: All-repeat tasks increase from 1 to 2, mixed tasks fall from 2 to 1, any-repeat tasks remain 3, and all-failure tasks remain 1.

evidence_to_claim.claim_or_action: No per-task pass-count regression was observed in these four tasks
evidence_to_claim.reason: Task deltas are 0,+1,+1,0 and the known-regression list is empty. This is not a claim that all possible regressions were assessed.

evidence_to_claim.claim_or_action: The recorded positive, negative, recovery and disabled-candidate conformance checks passed
evidence_to_claim.reason: All four supplied conformance conditions are true; this supports those checks, not guaranteed runtime enforcement.

evidence_to_claim.claim_or_action: F used 10 more requests, a 10% increase
evidence_to_claim.reason: The supplied request counts are 110 versus 100.

evidence_to_claim.claim_or_action: Universal, statistically established or production-enforced improvement
evidence_to_claim.reason: A four-task, four-repeat sample and aggregate counts do not establish those claims; model identity, token cost and enforcement details are not supplied.

checks.expected: Complete four tasks x four repeats in each arm
Fresh paired controls and fixed conditions

checks.observed: None observed in supplied four tasks

decision.artifact_acceptance: Limited positive study report accepted at the supplied evidence scope
decision.winner: not a production artifact acceptance request
decision.reason: The complete small paired study supports its descriptive positive result and recorded conformance checks, without authorizing more work or default adoption.

Report the passed conformance checks separately from task scores and disclose the request increase plus unknown token/cost telemetry.
Limit the conclusion to this fixed four-task study; stop without additional trials, installation, a new default or a broader claim.

Report the limited positive result and costs
withheld_in_scenario: Run new trials or models
Install or enable F by default
Claim statistical significance, universal improvement, known token/dollar cost or runtime enforcement
Treat fewer mixed outcomes alone as a success claim

budget.enforcement: planning/manual only; no runtime budget control is claimed
budget.allocation_note: No new scenario work authorized. Preserve the observed study counts: baseline 100 requests and F 110; tokens and monetary costs are unknown.

responses.permitted_next_action: Deliver the scoped study result and stop.
responses.final_user_facing_statement: In this completed four-task, four-repeat study, frozen F passed 10/16 trials (62.5%) versus 8/16 (50%) for fresh paired controls: +12.5 percentage points. Task pass counts were 4/4, 4/4, 2/4, 0/4 versus 4/4, 3/4, 1/4, 0/4. All-repeat tasks rose 1→2; any-repeat stayed 3; mixed fell 2→1; all-failure stayed 1. No per-task pass-count regression was observed. The recorded conformance checks passed. F used 110 requests versus 100 (+10%); tokens and dollar cost are unknown. This is a limited positive result for the tested sample, with no default-on installation or additional work.
